candidates.name: Gaussian scale-space potential-field edge-width concordance
layers: cached band 15: depth_to_base_surf as a baseline covariate
candidates.physical_signature: Cross-sensor coincidence of scale-normalized edge response, peak scale/width, and axial gradient normal over Gaussian scales 1, 2, 4, 8 pixels.
candidates.off_catalogue_rationale: A buried fault-related property boundary may be visible in both magnetic and gravity fields without a surface scarp or existing trace.
candidates.difference_from_repo: No cross-sensor Gaussian scale-space peak-width concordance implementation was found in src/ or scripts/. Existing local gradients, Hessians, Euler sheet index, upward continuation, and cross-strike lags are related but not this statistic. A related width-change idea appeared in an older review but no run was found.
candidates.named_non_fault_mimic: Intrusive/lithologic contacts, magnetization contrasts, and flight-line levelling seams.
candidates.relative_expected_improvement: moderate research priority; unknown; no numeric DTI projection
candidates.availability: local cached bands; source bytes are SHA-pinned owner mirrors, not organizer-authenticated

candidates.name: Visible-fault graph gap closure with physical-edge support
candidates.physical_signature: Short collinear, geophysically supported gaps between visible segment endpoints, scored with fold-safe endpoint orientation and graph connectivity.
candidates.off_catalogue_rationale: An unrecorded strand or continuation may occupy a structural gap between independently mapped segments.
candidates.difference_from_repo: No endpoint-graph centrality/gap-closure implementation was found. Related extension fields and line-placement methods are already implemented, increasing overlap risk.
candidates.named_non_fault_mimic: Drainage channels, map-generalization gaps, and aligned lithologic contacts.
candidates.relative_expected_improvement: low-to-moderate; unknown; no numeric DTI projection
candidates.availability: local labels/cache; fold-specific graph derivation required

candidates.name: Regime-conditioned World Stress Map orientation prior
candidates.physical_signature: Quality-weighted, regime-specific maximum horizontal stress orientation constraint; not a universal fault-trace azimuth.
candidates.off_catalogue_rationale: Regional normal-faulting stress can help reject geophysical lineaments inconsistent with new fault orientations.
candidates.difference_from_repo: No local WSM file or WSM-derived orientation likelihood found; existing strain features are not direct stress observations.
candidates.named_non_fault_mimic: Poor-quality/mixed-regime stress records and lithologic contacts.
candidates.required_official_source: GFZ Data Services, WSM Database Release 2025, DOI 10.5880/WSM.2025.001
candidates.obtainability_check: Not obtainable in this sandbox session: GFZ/DOI hosts are outside the outbound allowlist and no source file is in the manifest. Blocked; not viable.

candidates.name: GeoDAWN raw flight-line crossover and levelling residuals
candidates.physical_signature: Retain anomalies repeated across crossing flight directions while downweighting line-aligned levelling artifacts.
candidates.off_catalogue_rationale: Suppressing acquisition artifacts should reveal weaker geologic continuations in gridded fields.
candidates.difference_from_repo: Current local methods use gridded bands and block/seam deconfounding; no raw-profile crossover adjustment found.
candidates.named_non_fault_mimic: Acquisition striping, cultural infrastructure, and terrain-clearance effects.
candidates.obtainability_check: Not obtainable in this sandbox session: the USGS/DOI hosts are outside the outbound allowlist; raw profile files are absent from the manifest. Blocked; not viable.

candidates.name: Time-persistent groundwater-head barrier
layers: observed USGS groundwater levels and station metadata
candidates.physical_signature: A repeatable head discontinuity across independent wells and seasons, rather than a single DEM-derived topographic gradient.
candidates.off_catalogue_rationale: A buried low-permeability fault core may partition groundwater head where no surface trace is apparent.
candidates.difference_from_repo: GVSC's hydraulic term is DEM-derived; no observed-well time-series barrier model is implemented.
candidates.named_non_fault_mimic: Pumping cones, screen-depth differences, recharge, and lithology.
candidates.obtainability_check: Not obtainable in this sandbox session: the USGS API host is outside the outbound allowlist and no time-series data are local. AOI well density is unverified. Blocked; not viable.

experiment.baseline: B1 raw-19-band HistGradientBoosting with shared fold, sampled negatives, seeds, and emitter
experiment.candidate: same baseline plus one pre-registered cross-sensor edge-width concordance feature

holdout.holdout: whole 8-connected fault segments assigned whole to 4 spatial quadrants; 30-pixel/3 km training collar; pixel-exact exclusion of visible faults from scoring
holdout.metric: pooled DTI; alpha=0.2; beta=0.8; 300 m triangular kernel
holdout.bootstrap: paired spatial-cell bootstrap; seed and replicate count recorded in run card

experiment.feature_canary: each raw feature and new feature alone per fold; symmetric AUC > 0.90 triggers hard stop
experiment.promote_for_selector_only_if: candidate improves on matched baseline with paired 95% CI strictly above zero and beats the best recorded result for the exact evaluator; all surface and final-dot registry checks pass

candidate_feature_definition.per_sensor_descriptor: maximum scale-normalized response across scales, its argmax sigma, and its unit gradient normal
candidate_feature_definition.robust_normalization: divide each sensor peak response by its own 99th percentile over that sensor valid four-sigma-eroded footprint support; clip to [0,1]; label-free and deterministic; the concordance is emitted only on joint support
candidate_feature_definition.missing_data_and_boundary_rule: nearest-valid fill is for convolution only; exclude four-sigma halo from support; output zero outside joint support
